CVE-2021-41773.missing_control: no WAF rule for encoded paths
CVE-2021-41773.fix_text: Update httpd to 2.4.51 or later (2.4.50 was an incomplete fix).
CVE-2021-41773.kev_name: Apache HTTP Server Path Traversal Vulnerability
CVE-2021-41773.description: A flaw was found in a change made to path normalization in Apache HTTP Server 2.4.49. An attacker could use a path traversal attack to map URLs to files outside the directories configured by Alias-like directives. If files outside of these directories are not protected by the usual default configuration "require all denied", these requests can succeed. If CGI scripts are also enabled for these aliased pathes, this could allow for remote code execution. This issue is known to be exploited in the wild. CVE-2020-1472.headline_public: Anyone on the internet can take over the domain through {host}.
CVE-2020-1472.headline_internal: Anyone on the internal network can take over the domain through {host}.
CVE-2020-1472.fix_text: Install the August 2020 security update or later, then turn on Netlogon secure RPC enforcement.
CVE-2020-1472.description: An elevation of privilege vulnerability exists when an attacker establishes a vulnerable Netlogon secure channel connection to a domain controller, using the Netlogon Remote Protocol (MS-NRPC). An attacker who successfully exploited the vulnerability could run a specially crafted application on a device on the network. To exploit the vulnerability, an unauthenticated attacker would be required to use MS-NRPC to connect to a domain controller to obtain domain administrator access. CVE-2021-3156.headline_public: Any account that can sign in to {host} can make itself root.
CVE-2021-3156.headline_internal: Any account that can sign in to {host} can make itself root.
CVE-2021-3156.impact: turn any local account into root
CVE-2021-3156.description: Sudo before 1.9.5p2 contains an off-by-one error that can result in a heap-based buffer overflow, which allows privilege escalation to root via "sudoedit -s" and a command-line argument that ends with a single backslash character.

CVE-2021-34527.headline_public: Anyone who can reach the Print Spooler on {host} can run code as SYSTEM.
CVE-2021-34527.headline_internal: Anyone who can reach the Print Spooler on {host} can run code as SYSTEM.
CVE-2021-34527.asset: files and credentials on the host
CVE-2021-34527.missing_control: Print Spooler running where it is not needed
CVE-2021-34527.fix_text: Install the July 2021 out-of-band update or later; stop the Print Spooler on hosts that do not print.
CVE-2021-34527.kev_name: Microsoft Windows Print Spooler Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
CVE-2021-34527.description: A remote code execution vulnerability exists when the Windows Print Spooler service improperly performs privileged file operations. An attacker who successfully exploited this vulnerability could run arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges. An attacker could then install programs; view, change, or delete data; or create new accounts with full user rights. CVE-2021-4034.kev_name: Red Hat Polkit Out-of-Bounds Read and Write Vulnerability
CVE-2021-4034.description: A local privilege escalation vulnerability was found on polkit's pkexec utility. The pkexec application is a setuid tool designed to allow unprivileged users to run commands as privileged users according predefined policies. The current version of pkexec doesn't handle the calling parameters count correctly and ends trying to execute environment variables as commands. An attacker can leverage this by crafting environment variables in such a way it'll induce pkexec to execute arbitrary code. CVE-2023-0286.headline_public: A crafted certificate can crash or read memory from the TLS service on {host}.
CVE-2023-0286.headline_internal: A crafted certificate can crash or read memory from the TLS service on {host}.
CVE-2023-0286.impact: read memory or crash the TLS service
CVE-2023-0286.description: There is a type confusion vulnerability relating to X.400 address processing inside an X.509 GeneralName. X.400 addresses were parsed as an ASN1_STRING but the public structure definition for GENERAL_NAME incorrectly specified the type of the x400Address field as ASN1_TYPE. This field is subsequently interpreted by the OpenSSL function GENERAL_NAME_cmp as an ASN1_TYPE rather than an ASN1_STRING. CVE-2023-48795.headline_internal: Anyone in the network path can weaken SSH sessions to {host}.
CVE-2023-48795.fix_text: Update OpenSSH to 9.6p1 or later, or disable the affected ciphers and MACs.
